{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Clean revenue column — remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Step 2: Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99)
test_revenue_value = 999999.99
completed_filtered = df[
    (df['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (df['revenue_clean'] != test_revenue_value)
]

# Step 3: Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print result
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test): {total_revenue:,.2f}")"}
